output_text: {"request":"Write one read-only SQLite query returning every project ordered by id, with columns project_id, active_task_count, successful_latest_count.","constraints":["Active tasks have archived=0.","For each active task, select the latest attempt by greatest finished_at, then greatest attempt id for ties.","Count a task as successful only when its selected latest attempt has status='success'.","Tasks without attempts are not successful.","Include projects with no qualifying tasks.","Use SELECT or WITH followed by SELECT only.","Pre-aggregate active-task counts and latest-attempt success counts separately to avoid one-to-many multiplication.","Use LEFT JOIN and COALESCE for zero counts.","Count non-null task ids, not COUNT(*) on synthetic left-join rows.","Order deterministically by projects.id."],"schema":{"projects":["id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY"],"tasks":["id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY","project_id INTEGER","archived INTEGER"],"attempts":["id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY","task_id INTEGER","finished_at INTEGER","status TEXT"]},"source_ids":["task.request","task.schema","loaded_skills.sql"],"unresolved_issues":[] }
